name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.6.4 searches Shopify Global Catalog, reserves EXACT for strong product identity, and renders evidence-rich product cards with bounded snapshot hydration and bounded MCP App initialization retries. Card sizing is reported only after DOM render and first-image settlement, without ResizeObserver loops, while an app-only MCP tool records bounded lifecycle timings for active render snapshots. It queries a configured verified Deals API and binds persistent identity-specific price, promotion, inventory, and restock Watch rules to native Codex Automation. Product Watch creation requires a generation/model/GTIN and explicit condition. Monitoring becomes active only after its Automation ID is durably bound. Without approved data or affiliate relationships it fails closed and uses canonical merchant links. User-authorized Chrome remains a bounded one-time fallback, never an automated Watch source.
defaultPrompt: Search products, find verified deals, or create and bind a Watch to Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
